annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the webinar promotes BitClub Network as an income opportunity, claiming high recurring earnings and urging viewers to pay, join mining pools, and register through a referrer. Its displayed plan ties bonuses to sponsored participants’ share purchases and downstream purchases. The speaker cautions against borrowing and denies that it is a Ponzi, but those statements do not negate the described promotion and recruitment-linked compensation.

The opportunity includes a referral network, teams and tiered compensation tied to sponsored people purchasing mining-pool shares and to purchases by downstream participants.
